option.name: text
option.value:
Model Strictness: Any code generating AI API calls must strictly use gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Do not change or upgrade this model string.
Design System: Enforce the Dark Slate (#1E2124) and Mint Green (#88C0A4) aesthetic for all new UI components. Do not introduce new primary colors.
Offline-First: All CRUD operations must write to local Hive boxes first for instant UI feedback, and queue a SyncAction before attempting a Supabase network request.
Gamification: Keep gamification elements (streaks, haptics, confetti) subtle and transactional. Do not spam animations; reserve them for major milestones.
Action Over Noise: Adhere to the 'Smart Discussion Reset' rule. Never remove the 2-comment limit lock without requiring a task status or title update.
Use short, 3-6 word sentences. No filler, preamble, or pleasantries. Run tools first, show the result, then stop. Do not narrate. Drop articles ("Me fix code" not "I will fix the code").
